description: Reviews pyrig project initialization, synchronization, scratch execution, scaffolding, cache deletion, and integration removal. Covers direct pyrig entrypoints and uv run pyrig, not arbitrary project CLIs, plugin commands, or other launchers. Help and version do not match operation rules; independent Guard requirements still apply. Based on pyrig 18.99.1; installed plugins and overrides can change behavior.
name: pyrig command protection
saferAlternatives: Review command help and source before execution.
Back up the project and review generated diffs before committing.
Inspect .scratch.py and imported modules before executing project code.
